titulo: Cop31 talks go into overtime as debate rages over lack of fossil fuels in draft deal
cuerpo: African ministers say they ‘didn’t come here to beg’, with civil society groups calling it the ‘worst Cop ever’ Crucial climate talks headed into overtime on the last official day of the Cop31 UN summit as countries continued to argue over a draft deal that was silent on fossil fuels, with a host of other contentious issues complicating negotiations. Nearly 200 countries struggled to bridge their differences after two weeks of intense talks and impassioned speeches in Antalya, Turkey, about the effects of climate breakdown around the world, with a scheduled finish of Friday evening breached.
